paper_title: RLHF Workflow From Reward Modeling to Online RLHF
caption: The training record of preference modeling. From the left to right, we present the records of training loss, gradient norm, and the learning rate, respectively.
model_annotation: This line plot illustrates the training loss of a preference model over the course of training. The x-axis is labeled "Training Step," utilizing a linear scale with a displayed value range from 0 to approximately 1350, and features numeric tick labels spaced at intervals of 200. The y-axis is labeled "Training Loss," also on a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 14 with numeric tick labels at intervals of 2. The plot contains a single solid blue line with no markers, identified in the legend as "Training Loss of Preference Model." The line begins at its peak value of approximately 13.4 near x=0 and undergoes a sharp, immediate decline, dropping to approximately 0.2 by x=20. From this point onward, the line maintains a steady, nearly flat trend with very minor fluctuations, remaining just above 0 until it ends at approximately x=1310 with a final value near 0.1.
